text:
yara: opened a small PR to tidy up audit export wording and add Elixir + PHP snippets. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1407

ming: can you paste the PR summary?

yara: sure PR updates: replace 'TTL' with 'retention period' everywhere customer-facing, add explicit parenthetical about backups, remove literal example keys, and include Elixir + PHP examples for audit export. Also a short note recommending pseudonymization for actor identifiers.

julia: I'll own the Elixir snippet. Please confirm we want 90 days numeric example and an ISO example too.

legal: Use 'retention period' in public docs. When talking about deletion, say: "deleted from active storage (archival copies may persist per our backup policy)". Avoid any language that guarantees backups are erased immediately. Also add a line recommending pseudonymization or hashing of identifiers in exports.

yara: thanks, legal. I'll apply that exact phrasing. julia, show both 90 and P30D examples. Ming, can you do the PHP snippet and scrub any keys?

julia: pushed Elixir commit: ```elixir
client = Redwood.Client.new(api_key: "<API_KEY>")
stream = Redwood.Audit.export(client, scope: "account", retention: 90, format: "jsonl")
for line <- stream do
  IO.puts(line)
end
# ISO example
stream_iso = Redwood.Audit.export(client, retention: "P30D")
```

ming: added PHP commit: ```php
$client = new \Redwood\Client(getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'));
$stream = $client->audit()->export(['scope' => 'account', 'retention_days' => 90, 'format' => 'jsonl']);
foreach ($stream as $line) {
  echo $line . PHP_EOL;
}
```

linkchecker-bot: PR #1407 linkcheck: found redirected link /sdk/php -> /sdk/php/quickstart and /policies/backup -> /policies/data-backup. CI: https://ci.redwood/links/1407

yara: fixing links now. Also swapping any "destroyed" wording to the legal phrase. Replacing sample keys with <API_KEY> placeholders across the PR.

julia: added a tiny pseudonymize example to the migration note (Elixir): `actor_id = :crypto.hash(:sha256, actor_email) |> Base.encode16() |> binary_part(0,12)`

legal: LGTM on phrasing and pseudonymization note. One more ask: for partner-facing pages add contract caveat that exports can include raw identifiers only if contractually agreed.

yara: noted, will add partner caveat as a one-liner. CI run pending after link fixes.

docs-bot: docs-bot: running linters and link checks for PR #1407

linkchecker-bot: PR #1407 link check: PASS after fixes

yara: merged 389. I'll add a changelog entry and ping support to update internal runbooks about pseudonymization defaults for exports. Thanks all.
